_note: People named in real NSE filings. Every field below is stated in the cited filing's 'brief profile' (primary source). Hand-extracted as a seed and as a golden set for the extract_person LLM task. Years are null where the filing does not state them.

people.name: V. N. Srivatsan
people.bio: ~34 years of experience, ~25 in BFSI and ~10 in compliance and regulatory inspection. Led Retail Banking Compliance and Regulatory Inspection for 8+ years.

roles.title: Head - Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer

people.name: Anup Bagchi
people.role: Managing Director & CEO (in place of Sashidhar Jagdishan)
people.bio: Three decades across banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance. In the ICICI Group since 1992 (treasury, retail, wholesale and investment banking, digital financial services); former CEO & MD of an ICICI group company. RBI approved his appointment as HDFC Bank MD & CEO for 3 years from October 27, 2026.

people.name: Herjit Singh Bhalla
people.role: Whole-time Director; Chief Executive Officer - India Business (in place of Global CEO Mohit Malhotra)
people.bio: Joined Dabur earlier in 2026 as CEO - India Business. 25+ years building brands and scaling businesses; 16+ years at Unilever in management roles across India and international markets, then global leadership positions at The Hershey Company and METRO Cash & Carry India.

people.name: Ankush Jain
people.role: Chief Financial Officer, also designated Compliance Officer
people.bio: Presently Dabur's Chief Financial Officer; a qualified Company Secretary (ACS 18053). Takes on the Compliance Officer role when the Group Company Secretary superannuates on November 30, 2026.

people.name: Manoj Murali
people.bio: 25+ years in telecom and mobility across India and Africa; led turnarounds across sales, marketing, distribution, operations and customer experience. Last posted at Ola Electric as Chief Business Officer; earlier with Reliance Jio and Bharti Airtel.

people.name: Sudhir Ganesh Sitapati
people.bio: 25+ years in FMCG. MD & CEO of Godrej Consumer Products from October 2021 to August 2026; before that two decades at Hindustan Unilever, latterly Executive Director, Foods and Refreshments. Independent Director at Asian Paints; former member of Flipkart's advisory board.

roles.title: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer

people.name: Sidharatha Mishra
people.role: Senior Management (moves to ICICI Life as MD & CEO)
people.bio: 26+ years in banking. Headed ICICI Bank's digital channels and partnerships, voice channel, customer service, NRI and IFIG groups; transferred to ICICI Life as COO and then MD & CEO in place of Anup Bagchi.
